standard_prerequisites.statement: Delivered in context (source lines 215-221): the ADM mass is nonnegative when lambda_1 >= H/2, and zero mass forces flatness with constant boundary mean curvature.

standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: extends the Herzlich theorem to the glued manifold with Lipschitz metric (source line 257).

core_obligations: Strictly convex case: solve the quasi-spherical problem with u_0 = H_0/(2 lambda_1), so the inner boundary has constant mean curvature 2 lambda_1; the Herzlich theorem makes the ADM mass nonnegative, and (GeneralInequality) yields (NewUpperBound1); equality forces g_u flat, hence u = 1 and Sigma a round sphere, with the converse computed from the round sphere's eigenvalue (n-1)/(2r) and mean curvature (n-1)/r.

Star-shaped case with positive scalar and mean curvatures: deform by Eichmair-Miao-Wang to strictly convex Sigma_rho0, use the monotone quantity (Monotone1) and the Shi-Tam exterior construction (Monotone2), glue the two pieces along Sigma_rho0 and apply the Herzlich theorem via the corner version (Remark 2.4) to obtain the bound; the equality analysis proceeds as in the first case.
proof_roadmap: Two-case construction: quasi-spherical metric plus positive mass with compact inner boundary; the star-shaped case is reduced to the strictly convex one by the Eichmair-Miao-Wang deformation and a gluing monotonicity across a Lipschitz corner.
difficulty_reason: H2：113-119、224-258选quasi-spherical初值使内边界mean curvature=2lambda1，严格凸情形用spin positive-mass与mass monotonicity得sharp Dirac upper bound；star-shaped情形以inverse-curvature flow连接到凸slice，再把scalar-flat collar与AF exterior跨corner拼接，传递边界spectral condition并用mass rigidity闭合round-sphere等号。难点是边界Dirac谱/positive mass与非凸flow-and-gluing的相容，不以单独引用PMT或原H3标签判定。
